gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (trimmed p5, printed p9) prints Total expenditures 1,406,963 (Total Governmental Funds) with a blank Debt Service Fund expenditure column; on p6 (printed p10) the statement prints the Debt Service Fund's 'Debt principal payments - long-term debt' (180,000) and its part of 'Debt interest payments' (56,113) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (JSON other_financing -299,248 = -60,000 - 180,000 - 59,248). The Debt Service Fund budget schedule (trimmed p14, printed p44) prints the same money as DISBURSEMENTS: Bond retirement 180,000, Interest on bonds 55,713, Agent fees 400, Total disbursements 236,113 = 180,000 + 56,113; these are detail[71], detail[72], detail[73]. Every other fund's detail expenditure total equals its statement column (General 445,724 p11, Street 224,228, Sales Tax 6, Cemetery 22,036, Community Ambulance 469,481, Swimming Pool 111,198, Other Governmental 134,290 = Park 10,976 + Library 44,931 + Library Board 77,546 + Parks and Recreation Board 837, p21). 1,406,963 + 236,113 = 1,643,076 = schedule total. Nothing missing or duplicated; the schedule prints as disbursements what the statement prints as other financing uses. No fix.

Statement p6 General Fund column: 'Debt issuance - line of credit' 199,000 (= JSON debt_proceeds 199,000), 'Debt principal payments - line of credit' (60,000), 'Debt interest payments' (3,135); Debt Service Fund column: 'Debt principal payments - long-term debt' (180,000), 'Debt interest payments' (56,113). Detail has every printed line: General Fund budget schedule (p11) 'Loan (LOC)' 199,000 = detail[36], 'Loan - payment' (60,000) = detail[37], 'Loan - interest' (3,135) = detail[38]; the Debt Service Fund 180,000 + 56,113 are in detail as expenditure lines detail[71]-[73] (p14, see the expenditure gap). Non-transfer other-financing detail = 199,000 - 60,000 - 3,135 = 135,865; debt_proceeds 199,000 - 135,865 = 63,135 = 60,000 + 3,135 (loan repayment and interest, which the JSON carries in other_financing, not debt_proceeds). debt_proceeds + other_financing = 199,000 - 299,248 = -100,248; the difference to 135,865 is the Debt Service Fund 236,113 held in detail as disbursements. No proceeds line is missing; adding the 180,000 / 56,113 as other financing would count them twice. No fix.
